operating_days: Monday to Saturday (Closed: Sundays and Year-end/New Year holidays Dec 29 – Jan 3)

passes.note: Ticket books (11 tickets for the price of 10) are available for purchase.

reservation_methods.note: Reservations must be made at least 30 minutes prior to use.

reservation_window: From 1 week in advance until 30 minutes before boarding
important_notes: Users must complete a one-time registration at the Town Hall.
Pickup and drop-off are between designated 'Common Points' or private homes (for registered residents).
Wait times may occur due to the shared nature of the service.
